name: Deep Sea Dating
source:
Deep Sea Dating is a short kinetic novel set in the Touhou universe. Follow Wakasagi, beleaguered mermaid princess, as she tries to make a good first impression on her werewolf girlfriend!

[From [url=https://fionakaenbyou.itch.io/deep-sea-dating]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《深海约会》是一部以《东方Project》宇宙为舞台的短篇动词小说。跟随身心疲惫的人鱼公主若鹭姬，努力给自己的狼人女友留下良好第一印象！

[来源：[url=https://fionakaenbyou.itch.io/deep-sea-dating]Itch.io[/url]]
